purpose: Test fresh bar-based intraday hypotheses in liquid US ETFs without reusing or retuning the failed futures price-transfer rules.

data.universe_rationale: Preselected liquid ETF proxies for broad US equity, Nasdaq growth, gold and crude-oil exposure; no post-result substitution.
data.gap_policy: No interpolation. Any signal, entry or exit requiring a missing exact minute is ineligible.

execution.entry: next exact one-minute bar open after signal
execution.commissions: not separately modeled; friction haircut is all-in proxy for D0 only

ETF_H1_ORB15_CONTINUATION.signal: first close strictly above opening-range high => long; first close strictly below opening-range low => short

ETF_H2_VWAP_VOL_REVERSION.cumulative_vwap: sum(minute_vwap * minute_volume) / sum(minute_volume) from 09:30 through signal minute
ETF_H2_VWAP_VOL_REVERSION.volatility: sample standard deviation of the preceding 20 exact one-minute log close-to-close returns
ETF_H2_VWAP_VOL_REVERSION.signal: first z >= +1.0 => short; first z <= -1.0 => long

ETF_H3_GAP_REVERSION.daily_sigma: sample standard deviation of prior 20 regular-session close-to-close log returns
ETF_H3_GAP_REVERSION.signal: positive gap => short; negative gap => long

gates.promotion: No direct promotion from D0 or D3. A survivor gets a new candidate ID and prospective future shadow only.
